requested_changes.title: PID existence and Job membership do not prove that the runner is still active
requested_changes.evidence: GetProcessTimes fills the exited FILETIME but it is never inspected; no GetExitCodeProcess/STILL_ACTIVE check is made. A terminated process retained by an open process/Job handle can still be queried and retain its creation identity and Job membership.
requested_changes.impact: arm may label OBSERVED_LIVE_PID_AND_CREATION and publish an authority bundle for a PID that has already exited; the downstream runner cannot consume this bundle. This does not prove an actual execution bypass, and no candidate was run.
requested_changes.requested_change: After querying identity and membership, require a typed successful liveness observation (e.g. GetExitCodeProcess == STILL_ACTIVE together with zero exit FILETIME) before returning. Keep handle cleanup in finally and label the result point-in-time only. Add a pure-data/structural negative check for an exited PID with retained handle, and a positive suspended/running PID case without importing the candidate.
